snippet.title: False Alarm - Official Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
False Alarm is a 2D stealth action game that takes inspiration from Hitman, Mark of the Ninja, Metal Gear Solid, Gunpoint, Deadbolt and more.

Demo out now on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688650/False_Alarm/
